independent_verification.actual_metadata: 79 JSON metadata pins and 360 score/status cells checked; raw score tensors and outcome files were guarded against reads
independent_verification.actual_journal: No-op reconciliation passed while Ledger construction was forbidden; database bytes and complete M02 history matched before and after
independent_verification.temporary_journal: Record-once, read-only retry, compare-and-swap, corrupted object rejection, and commit-before-output retry were exercised only against temporary ledgers

review_findings_and_resolutions.finding: Reconciliation originally trusted the request embedded in the comparison receipt without an independent request pin.
review_findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Reconciliation now accepts the separately pinned request and compares its verified pin to the embedded request before reconstructing the receipt.

review_findings_and_resolutions.finding: The already-decided path could accept failure outcome or extra reference roles.
review_findings_and_resolutions.resolution: It now requires success, retain, exact evaluation/review references, matching revision, and verified registered artifact bytes. Regression tests cover failure and extra-reference rejection.

review_findings_and_resolutions.finding: The initial native graph checks did not bind frozen selected terminals, attempts, common-race support, or all prelabel gates.
review_findings_and_resolutions.resolution: The bridge now checks all 12 selected terminal pins and attempts, each fold's common support against the frozen mask, the journal support vector, core/bulk/bank/tail gates, and label-access metadata without reading raw outcomes.

review_findings_and_resolutions.finding: The score report could accept incomplete arm/metric/status rosters and risk conflating numerical precision with scientific qualification.
review_findings_and_resolutions.resolution: The bridge enforces the five score arms and four metrics across cycle/tier masks, validates cell statuses and values, and labels the result only as conditional numerical precision. It preserves the LP5/2020 interval-display limitation and unresolved/empty cells.

review_findings_and_resolutions.finding: Post-commit output failure must not duplicate a journal checkpoint.
review_findings_and_resolutions.resolution: A temporary-ledger fault-injection test retries with the same command ID, pinned request and comparison in a fresh executor attempt/output directory; the bridge returns the recorded command through a read-only snapshot. The partial earlier output remains preserved.

review_findings_and_resolutions.finding: Native empty-mask cells and equal-cycle summaries must remain unavailable when a constituent score is null.
review_findings_and_resolutions.resolution: The bridge now requires empty_binary_or_race_mask cells to have null value, zero count and false precision, and requires missing-cycle nulls to propagate as metric_unresolved at tier level. Tests reject a numeric zero in the empty 2022 near-even cycle and in A near-even tier.

scope_and_limitations.verified: Metadata bytes, explicit source links, native selection/mask/arm/cycle bindings, score-status structure, request/receipt equality, exact M02 journal binding and idempotent journal behavior.
scope_and_limitations.not_verified: Raw prediction tensors, outcome source contents, numerical score recomputation, model fit correctness, bank revalidation, or independent scientific review itself.
scope_and_limitations.interpretation: This is a metadata and evidence-reconciliation bridge. The prior independent review, root acceptance and retain decision remain separately pinned claims; this bridge does not create scientific qualification, full-count qualification, promotion, a publication authorization, or an active model change.
